note: Services photo cards, in this order. One photo per card from projects.json (project ids). A card with an empty photo is skipped and renders by itself once a photo id is set (Siding: data-confirm=photo-needed, the client has no siding photo yet, the Siding pill shows until then). line is the descriptor shown on hover or tap: plain description only, no timelines, prices, warranties, licenses or results. The client approves the lines. chip is the form chip the quote action selects (Something else when the form has no chip for that service). Never put a photo under a service it does not show. The last 8 cards are stock photo cards: photo is a file stem in site/assets/projects/ (stem-640.webp and stem-960.webp, 960 by 640), empty means a neutral placeholder card; stock true marks a stock photo the client can swap for a project photo; service is the name sent in the hidden origin_service field; enabled false hides a card. Electrical, plumbing, HVAC and mold may need separate Washington licenses. Desktop shows the first 6, the rest sit behind Show all services. category is Inside, Outside or Add space. placeholder true marks a card that still has no photo; it shows a dark card with a line icon and the name.
